scope: Source-level verification of the Codex hooks engine for future adapter build-out. No hook was installed, dispatched, or answered; no Codex binary was requalified; no live delivery, trust, loss, or response behavior is claimed. Findings are dated observations of the inspected upstream revision, not adapter capability.
sanitization: Public upstream revisions, tags, PR numbers, and artifact digests only; no machine names, account IDs, credentials, private transcripts, or user-specific absolute paths.

source_basis.inspected_revision: 1f69eb089d (local daily-merge checkout of openai/codex; merge base with upstream main is 17f29f3ff8, merged 2026-10-18T03:02Z)
source_basis.baseline_comparison: rust-v0.157.1 (the 2026-09-27 survey baseline), queried through the GitHub contents API per file
source_basis.installed_binary_observation: The PATH-resolved codex was rebuilt 2026-10-18 to sha256 da306dac94448fa745dae78f42f049cb986fd7fb09aef34a54c10169f2e966fe (reports codex-cli 0.0.0). This digest is not in Observer::qualifiedBinarySha256s(), so managed-Codex structured attention stays disabled until the requalification procedure runs; that run is the natural vehicle for the first live hooks probe.
source_basis.feature_flag: hooks listed stable and enabled on the inspected build's features listing

verified_surface.handlers: HookHandlerType command | mcp_tool | prompt | agent; HookExecutionMode sync | async; HookScope thread | turn; matcher groups per event in the [hooks] config table (codex-rs/config/src/hook_config.rs)
verified_surface.command_handler_fields: command, commandWindows, timeout, async, statusMessage, additionalContextLimit (context spills to disk past a 2,500-token default, 0 disables)

decision_semantics.pre_tool_use: Can block with a reason and rewrite tool input (updated_input). Present at 0.157.1 (32 references in events/pre_tool_use.rs at that tag), so this is newly recorded by lapis, not newly added upstream.
decision_semantics.permission_request: Handlers return Allow or Deny{message}; decisions fold any-deny-wins, else last allow, else no verdict; the event runs in the approval path before Guardian or user approval UI. Response folding documented in codex-rs/hooks/src/events/permission_request.rs.
decision_semantics.stop: stop_hook_active continuation guard, last_assistant_message, changed-files collection (max 1,000 files, 5 s git timeout); targets Stop, internal MemoryConsolidation, and SubagentStop{agent_id, agent_type, transcript}; SubagentStop matchers key on agent_type. A Stop hook never proves task completion.

verified_surface.output_parsing: Claude-compatible decision JSON (hookSpecificOutput, permissionDecision, permissionDecisionReason, updatedInput, block reasons) parsed by the engine's output parser
verified_surface.schemas: Per-event command input/output JSON schemas are generated and shipped by codex-rs/hooks/src/schema.rs; machine-readable contract material for adapter normalizers

app_server_surface.hooks_list: hooks/list (HooksListParams{cwds} -> HooksListResponse{data: [HooksListEntry{cwd, hooks, warnings, errors}]}) in protocol v2 beside the plugin/* marketplace methods
app_server_surface.run_notifications: hook/started and hook/completed carry thread_id, turn_id, and HookRunSummary (id, event_name, handler_type, execution_mode, scope, source_path, source, status, status_message, timing). These notifications existed at 0.157.1; hooks/list did not.

verified_surface.tui: /hooks slash command (hooks browser); hook status titles (#51433) and ANSI styles in hook messages (#50359) shipped in 0.162
verified_surface.distribution_and_trust: codex plugin add/list/marketplace/remove; HooksFile manifests (description plus events); [hooks.state] per-hook enabled, trusted_hash, trusted_content_hash; plugin hook approval bound to plugin contents (#54619); managed layer with allow_managed_hooks_only and managed requirements dirs

lapis_relevance.h0_inventory_candidate: The app-server exposes hooks/list for bounded inventory enumeration. The presence of hook/started and hook/completed notifications does not establish that a separately resumed observer receives them; runtime delivery scope requires a live probe.
lapis_relevance.h1_per_session_decision_hook: A lapis-owned PermissionRequest command hook configured only in the session's disposable Codex home would give the PTY-launched TUI an approval-answering route; strictly per-session opt-in because it changes the agent's execution policy.
lapis_relevance.h2_subagent_visibility: SubagentStart/SubagentStop expose Codex-internal fan-out identity as advisory signals.
lapis_relevance.constraints: Qualification only on a requalified binary; never install global or shared hooks; Stop hooks never map to task completion; schema presence is not delivery evidence; owner-scoped notification routing cannot be generalized to a separate observer without a live receipt.

non_claims: No hook dispatch, payload identity, trust flow, loss/reconnect, notification routing, or decision round trip was exercised by this source survey. The inspected revision is a daily merge with local build commits on top, not a released artifact. TUI /hooks browser behavior is recorded from source and release notes only. No upstream contribution was made or drafted.
